description: Source code defining a router with multiple endpoints for econometrics analysis functions, including correlation matrix, OLS regression, stationarity tests, panel data models, causality tests, and VIF calculations.

methods.name: OBBject[list[Data]] correlation_matrix( data: list[Data], method: Literal["pearson", "kendall", "spearman"] = "pearson" )
methods.description: Get the correlation matrix of an input dataset, supporting different methods like Pearson, Kendall, Spearman.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] ols_regression( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Perform Ordinary Least Squares regression on the dataset, returning model and results objects.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] ols_regression_summary( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Perform OLS regression and return a detailed statistical summary, including coefficients and diagnostics.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] autocorrelation( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Perform Durbin-Watson test for autocorrelation in residuals from a regression model.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] residual_autocorrelation( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], lags: PositiveInt = 1, )
methods.description: Perform Breusch-Godfrey Lagrange Multiplier test for autocorrelation in residuals.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] cointegration( data: list[Data], columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Conduct Engle-Granger two-step test to assess co-integration between pairs of time series.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] causality( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_column: str, lag: PositiveInt = 3, )
methods.description: Perform Granger causality test to analyze predictive relationships between time series.

methods.name: OBBject[Data] unit_root( data: list[Data], column: str, regression: Literal["c", "ct", "ctt"] = "c", )
methods.description: Conduct Augmented Dickey-Fuller test to check for stationarity (presence of a unit root) in time series.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_random_effects( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Fit a Random Effects model for panel data.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_between( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Estimate a Between estimator regression for panel data.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_pooled( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Apply Pooled OLS regression on panel data assuming no entity or time effects.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_fixed( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Estimate fixed effects regression models for panel data, controlling for entity/time heterogeneity.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_first_difference( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Run first-difference regression analysis on panel data to eliminate time-invariant heterogeneity.

methods.name: OBBject[dict] panel_fmac( data: list[Data], y_column: str, x_columns: list[str], )
methods.description: Estimate Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions for panel data.

methods.name: OBBject[list[Data]] variance_inflation_factor( data: list[Data], columns: Optional[list] = None )
methods.description: Calculate Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) for detecting multicollinearity among regressors.
